title: Fractional-mask unary and finite-scalar math through actual tile kernels and CSV readback

entry_inventory.meaning: Entry names only; not full signatures, defaults or numerical equivalence

implementation: Lift only direct weighted unary or exactly one weighted image plus a source-free finite scalar. Preserve official operand order, band pairing/broadcast, source lineage, observations and ownership.

Validate original science through strict apply(raw,1) before computation. Preserve nominal Float32/Double stages despite physical Double mask projections. result_value keeps finite bits and maps arithmetic/cast NaN and Infinity to NoData; result validity gates the original weight, never replaces it with1.

Reuse existing arithmetic, comparisons, Boolean logic, casts, clamp/unitScale, expression and Float32 scientific callbacks. Boolean zero remains valid independently of mask weights. Special Double callbacks still require explicit toFloat.

Fold finite compound scalars only after a freshly charged full immutable DAG plan, with cached-occurrence subtree heights and unchanged depth96/work50000/node500 bounds. Reuse the declared round policy in both constant folders so already integral large Double values and signed zero survive. Both finite constant folders also reuse floor/ceil with signed-zero preservation; ceil of a negative fraction now agrees with the existing native IEEE policy.
Keep unsupported two-raster/conditional/nested mask consumers intact for explicit rejection. Bare weighted raster map/statistics/export are not unlocked by sampling support.

Add one closed native result_value operation with unchanged source Infinity checks, arities, canonical spec and cell/key/work budgets. Build all70 current adapter sources into a separate non-deployment audit JAR; verify source/helper/tool/classpath hashes before both new and existing weighted-sampling native tests.
Update Python70/JS24 examples, syntax reference, architecture and engineering instructions; keep shared manifest verification modular.

focused_round_and_scalar_regression.scope: Official scalar operand wire bits including signed zero, shared constant folds and existing constant/scalar-work suites

official_clients.scope: Offline official SDK serialization and local compilation of mask getters plus representative sampling consumers

comparison_policy.basic_double_and_casts: bit-exact, including16777219.25 wide_add_right; a Float32-narrowed result is an explicit failing control
comparison_policy.double_libm: at most4 ULP; exact zero/tiny controls
comparison_policy.float32_special_callbacks: only named existing Float32 functions use3e-5 relative/3e-6 absolute, calibrated separately

native_tile_probe.execution_scope: Actual local GeoTrellis Float64/Float32 tile kernels, mask apply/result_value/validity/update, and existing Image.sample kernel. The Scala probe is compiled in a temporary directory; no SparkContext, engine service, VM, container, private data, or Google request is used.

atan2_signed_zero_native_control.meaning: Actual existing kernel outputs negative/positive Float32 pi; no JAR rebuild

physical_csv_readback.scope: Trusted synthetic orchestration using real native rows, not full batch-engine execution

independent_review.deduplication_rule: Canonical sorted-key exact JSON, with metadata/options/variants included for compile-input identities; this is not semantic equivalence deduplication.
independent_review.scope: Scoped correctness/resource/ownership review, not full repository security audit. The22 unsupported broad positive cases remain open; rejected cases and repeated inputs are not compatibility coverage. Numerical graph interpretation is separate from the actual native workflow.
independent_review.signed_zero_policy_note: The original fixture retains its measured pre-fix Python +0 expectation for ceil(-.2). Two accepted cases now intentionally differ from that old policy and match the separately frozen independent NumPy/existing native -0 rule. Floor/ceil(-0) weighted regressions recover the original plain-path -0. The4 explicit Double atan2 guards remain rejected.

failures_preserved: Shared subtree revisit could hide a longest scalar path before folding: original official payloads with actual depths109/106 were accepted. The full planner now rejects them at depth96; the original within-limit case remains accepted.

Source-free rounded Double operands at +/-(2^52+1) were each changed by1 before emitting subtract wire constants. Both original payloads now preserve the exact operand; boundary/tie/signed-zero tests also cover both common folders.

New weighted scalar folding lost negative zero after floor/ceil, unlike the accepted plain path: emitted atan2 y changed from-0 to+0 and actual native x=-1 output changes from negative to positive Float32 pi. Original SDK payloads now retain-0 in both paths. Separately, the pre-existing Python ceil(-.2)=+0 policy is intentionally aligned to NumPy/existing native-0; both old policy expectations remain recorded, not rewritten.
Compound source-free constant math initially reached a typed raster compiler that required a raster operand; complete finite scalar folding now retains cast stages and Double promotion.

Old scalar-arithmetic-negative and cast-IR-shape assertions failed after intentional support expansion; actual same-source raster negatives remain and new positive matrices cover the newly supported behavior.
The initial broad value comparator could accept Float32 narrowing of16777219.25. Final tests select precision by output operation/dtype and reject that narrowed counterexample.

A full-package baseline overlay relocated S2 resources and caused a harness-only resource failure; baseline comparison now overlays only changed modules. Original default sample wires were not replaced.
One forged internal Boolean-carrier rejection expectation was not justified; its original failure remains, and the final check enforces actual Double truth precision instead.

Empty ee.Image receiver failures remain open, including the original shallow shared-expression positive. Separately frozen constant(0)-receiver controls isolate the depth defect without rewriting those originals.
limits_and_unverified: No automatic Google compute/auth/quota calls. Remote comparison is discussed only for exceptionally complex behavior not reliably resolved by documentation and independent local references.

Unary/finite-unmasked-scalar fractional-weight propagation is an explicitly labeled local inference. Official docs establish shared valid support but do not specify a general fractional magnitude combination for two independent raster masks; no min/product rule or Google equivalence is claimed.

Two-raster fractional math, ND/multiband expression, empty ee.Image() receiver, where/unmask/integer casts, spherical partial-pixel clip, weighted reductions, alpha display and raster weight export remain open.

Source-free compound constants must stay finite under the existing bounded scalar contract. This does not introduce global constant grids, arbitrary dynamic scalar expressions or source borrowing from masks.
No full Spark batch, service/browser/isolated script, private real-data or deployment acceptance. Sampling null/default/schema/seed policies remain unchanged and are not Google RNG parity.

Current70-source audit JAR is non-deployable and not installed. Its245 runtime hashes match the explicit audit classpath, but public provenance remains39 matches/7 mismatches/199 unlisted. This is not a vulnerability finding or clean-security claim.
Existing three strict S2 binary64 incidence/roundtrip differences and other full geometry/projection/default gaps remain unresolved.
Portable CI skips only the absent ignored audit artifact; malformed present manifests, directories or broken symlinks fail closed. A CI skip is not native acceptance.
No dependency/lock/user-data/environment or runtime-service changes. Full production and compatibility goals remain active.
publication_policy: Exact frozen commit must pass python/frontend on its owned validation branch before a normal fast-forward to protected main; no PR, bypass or protection change.
